frozenMismatches.finding: The frozen AnalyzeRule.kt:686 splits the rule on the literal "##" and Kotlin's split keeps the trailing empty field, so ruleStrS.size == 4 and AnalyzeRule.kt:695 sets replaceFirst = true. Kotlin 2.1.0 split("##") on this rule returns [#meta@text, 忘语, 忘语先生, ""] (verified on this host), so the handset's "忘语先生" is the frozen behavior. The Windows adapter (and the source reading behind the corpus expectation) used the Java-split reading of three fields. Owner: the adapter's replacement-field parser; the fixture was not edited (boundary rule).
